heading: Liberalised Remittance Scheme: Navigating RBI Curbs & Remittance Strategy
tldr: The Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) allows resident Indians to send up to USD 250,000 abroad per financial year for various purposes.
Recent market speculation suggests the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) might introduce further restrictions on certain LRS transactions.
Investors are currently weighing whether to remit funds in a lump sum now or opt for staggered transfers, anticipating potential policy changes.
Understanding the existing Tax Collected at Source (TCS) rules on LRS remittances is crucial for financial planning.
A careful assessment of individual financial goals and risk appetite is essential before making any remittance decisions.
caption:
Thinking of sending money abroad from India? It's a common question for many, especially with recent talks about possible changes to how much you can send. Our new article breaks down the rules for sending money out of India, what to consider when planning your transfers, and how potential policy changes might affect you. Read on to understand your options better.
